name: Celery

schedule.notes: Surface-sow; needs light to germinate. Slow grower.
After hardening off — sudden cold causes bolting.
Heavy feeder. Steady moisture is everything — stress = stringy stalks.
Cut outer stalks anytime; or harvest whole head at the base.

harvest.cues: Stalks 8+ in, firm, before flower stalk appears.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge crisper 2 to 3 weeks in plastic. Freezes well chopped, lost crunch but flavor holds.

varieties.name: Tall Utah 52-70
varieties.notes: The grocery-store celery. Crisp, large stalks.

varieties.name: Redventure
varieties.notes: Striking red stalks, slightly more flavorful, more cold-tolerant.

notes: Wants constant moisture — never let it dry out or stalks turn stringy and bitter. Blanch outer stalks by wrapping with cardboard 2 weeks before harvest for sweeter flavor.
